segments.name: Battery-grade graphite business
segments.description: Develops battery-grade natural graphite products for lithium-ion battery manufacturers and other customers via the Kellyton Graphite Plant and Coosa Graphite Deposit.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reporting segment, the "battery-grade graphite business" segment and the Company's chief operating decision maker ("CODM") is the President & Chief Executive Officer.

changes.text: The company shifted its strategic focus to the graphite business in 2017.
changes.evidence: Although the Company was originally incorporated in 1977, it shifted its strategic focus to the graphite business in 2017.

changes.text: The company acquired Alabama Graphite in 2018, adding the Coosa Graphite Deposit.
changes.evidence: The acquisition of Alabama Graphite in 2018, which added the Coosa Graphite Deposit to the Company's asset base, provides the Company with the opportunity to pursue a domestic supply of battery-grade natural graphite products for U.S. and allied markets by combining an upstream resource position at Coosa Graphite Deposit with downstream processing at the Kellyton Graphite Plant.
